nl: In docs/install.md, insert the line `- 1 GB of free disk space` directly after the line `- 512 MB of memory`.

entries.content_utf8:
# Orders API

`GET /orders` returns all orders.
`POST /orders/new` creates an order.
Reference: http://example.com/orders/api

# Changelog

## 2.3.0

- Added the customers API.

## 2.2.0

- Added order export.

# Configuration

The service reads `config.toml` from the working directory.

## Database

Set `database.url`. The default is `sqlite://orders.db`.

## Logging

Set `log.level` to `debug`, `info` or `warn`.

# Orders service

See [installation](install.md) and [configuration](config.md).
Source code: http://example.com/orders/source

# Installation

Download the release from http://example.com/orders/releases.
Verify the checksum published at http://example.com/orders/sha256.

## Requirements

- Linux, macOS or Windows
- 512 MB of memory

docs/install.md.text:
# Installation

Download the release from http://example.com/orders/releases.
Verify the checksum published at http://example.com/orders/sha256.

## Requirements

- Linux, macOS or Windows
- 512 MB of memory
- 1 GB of free disk space

oracle_program: lines "docs/install.md" |> filter text == "- 512 MB of memory" |> insert "- 1 GB of free disk space" position: after
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('docs/install.md')
t = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
p.write_text(t.replace('- 512 MB of memory\n', '- 512 MB of memory\n- 1 GB of free disk space\n', 1), encoding='utf-8')
EOF
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'docs/install.md'
$t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$a = '- 512 MB of memory'
$n = '- 1 GB of free disk space'
$i = $t.IndexOf($a); $e = $t.IndexOf("`n", $i)
$eol = if ($t[$e - 1] -eq "`r") { "`r`n" } else { "`n" }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Insert($e + 1, $n + $eol))
